messages:
lena: FYI folks — CI flagged a compatibility mismatch between sdk-js v3.5.0 and runtime 2.16 under high-concurrency. recommending a targeted sdk pin for canaries to v3.4.2 while we validate. requesting soft-pin across prod-eu canaries for 2h. deploybot?

deploybot: action=pin sdk=3.4.2 scope=prod-eu duration=2h requested_by=lena status=queued

omar: quick question: is this a behavioral change (output diffs) or a perf/memory regression? need to decide soft vs hard.

lena: mostly memory spikes in the sdk shim when we hit >150 concurrent sessions. outputs unchanged in bulk checks but some OOMs in the canary pods. Risk to customer sessions is medium. plan: soft-pin first to avoid routing thrash.

release-council-bot: NOTE: sdk pins must be documented in the release log and communicated to customer-success if they affect committed SLAs.

deploybot: action=pin sdk=3.4.2 scope=prod-eu duration=2h requested_by=lena status=success expires_at=3900019698

sasha: infra note: when you pin SDKs we sometimes see uneven binpacking across nodes due to image caching. if we're keeping pin longer we should consider a rolling-restart plan to avoid hot pods on a few hosts. tagging @infra-oncall for input.

infra-oncall: acknowledged. recommend a staggered restart with 30s buffer per pod and a max parallelism=5. Will prepare a restart window if you decide more than 4h.

omar: mitigation steps: 1) revert sdk-client runtime shim change introduced in 3.5.0 (small patch) and push 3.5.1-canary; 2) if that fails, keep pin until patch released; 3) if patch regresses, perform model routing to lower-concurrency pool.

lena: timeline proposal: extend soft-pin to 4h if canary shows >95% stability after 30m. Omar, can you push 3.5.1-canary tag and call out the fix?

omar: will push canary: sdk-js:3.5.1-canary-390 and run concurrency suite. ETA ~50m.

qa-bot: queued: concurrency-smoke-suite against sdk-js:3.5.1-canary-390 in prod-eu-canary; expected duration 35m.

deploybot: note: soft-pin semantics: traffic prefers pinned SDK version but will fallback to other SDK versions if capacity/policy requires. To enforce strict routing use /deploybot pin-hard-sdk.

lena: agreed on soft-pin. Sasha, infra-oncall, please standby for rolling restart if we extend beyond 4h. Omar, attach artifact URLs to the ticket. I'll update the release notes stub: "SDK: temporary canary pin for prod-eu due to concurrency OOMs; mitigation: small shim revert in 3.5.1-canary; timeline and escalation links."

release-council-bot: Reminder: add changelog under "sdk-compatibility" and include the deploybot command used and the pin expiry time.

omar: pushed 3.5.1-canary-390 -> logs: https://ci.redwood/artefacts/390/sdk-3.5.1-canary-390/logs. Running load now.

qa-bot: concurrency-smoke-suite finished -> 0/60 failures vs canary. memory p50 reduced from 1.8GB->1.1GB in canary runs.

lena: great. plan: if no OOMs in 30m live traffic, we'll lift pin and schedule a staged rollout of 3.5.1-canary to canary fleets. Who will lift the pin?

sasha: I'll coordinate rollout and watch node distribution. infra-oncall will execute restarts if we see hotspotting.

deploybot: upcoming command examples:

# soft SDK pin
/deploybot pin sdk=3.4.2 scope=prod-eu duration=4h
# hard SDK pin (strict routing)
/deploybot pin-hard-sdk sdk=3.4.2 scope=prod-eu
# lift pin
/deploybot unpin sdk=3.4.2 scope=prod-eu

lena: thanks all. leaving soft-pin in place for now. will post final status update in ~1h.
